HOW TO BUILD THIS DOC

Criteria that name 320, 768, root 24 px, the bottom sheet, compact navigation or touch are **withdrawn**. Existing responsive code stays — nothing is removed from a component for this. A check that fails only under 1024 px is **listed, not fixed**. **Consequence recorded with it:** the matrix harness's cell sets hold desktop cells only — `full` 8 (1024 and 1440 × light / dark × zh-CN / en, default text size), `smoke` 4, `stress` 2 (at 1024), passes and previews at 1024 and 1440 light zh-CN; 200% zoom is not a cell (at these widths it is a 512 or 720 CSS px layout). **Unchanged:** D-43; no sideways page scroll and no clipped text at the accepted widths; names, roles, states, keyboard operation, visible focus; both locales; light and dark | `CLAUDE.md` § Hard rules 11 (note there), § Common commands (`npm run matrix`); `FOUNDATIONS.md` § Verification matrix; `RESPONSIVE.md` (note at the top, § Verifying); the `/responsive` skill; `e2e/matrix/cells.mjs`, `self-test.mjs`, `README.md`; narrows D-34 (the matrix axes) and the done-checks of `docs/specs/lofi-prototype-*.md` (per-criterion evidence, `--all` at 44 cells, the per-package passes, every criterion at 320 / 768 / root 24 px) | Owner, in conversation 2026-11-26 (relayed by the orchestration session, brief `I5`) |

It holds wherever the block is used (排班, 预约, 日程, the gallery).
